text: Quietly. Something down there is always listening.

choices.label: Tell me about the world beyond.

text: You came back up. Good. Not everyone does. Sit, and keep your voice low.

choices.label: Tell me about the world beyond.

text: I carved this island myself, one candle at a time. I keep them lit. The dark is respectful if you are.
The blind fool guards a world of endless caves. Anger clouds his judgement; he knows no friend from foe.
The caves below grow more dangerous the longer you hunt them, and they test anyone who stays.
Nobody knows for certain. There is only the old saying:
“The door remembers who was there at the end.”
Make of it what you will. I've said too much already.
Their mightiest creatures carry what is worth taking.
Light and patience keep a miner alive. Mostly light.
